# Jeremiah 24 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** YHWH showed-me, and-behold, two baskets-of figs set before the-temple-of YHWH — after Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon had-taken-captive Jeconiah son-of Jehoiakim king-of Judah and-the-princes-of Judah and-the-craftsmen and-the-smiths from-Jerusalem and-brought-them to-Babylon.

**2** And-YHWH declared concerning two baskets of figs through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**3** And-YHWH declared concerning two baskets of figs through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH declared concerning two baskets of figs through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**5** "Thus says YHWH God-of Israel: 'Like these good figs, so I-will-regard the-exiles-of Judah whom I-sent from this place to-the-land-of [the]-Chaldeans, for-good.

**6** And-I-will-set My-eyes upon-them for-good, and-I-will-bring-them-back to this land; and-I-will-build-them and-not tear-down, and-I-will-plant-them and-not uproot.

**7** And-I-will-give-them a-heart to-know-Me, that I [am] YHWH, and-they-will-be to-Me for-a-people and-I will-be to-them for-God, for they-will-return to-Me with-all their-heart."

**8** And-YHWH declared concerning two baskets of figs through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**9** And-YHWH declared concerning two baskets of figs through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**10** And-YHWH declared concerning two baskets of figs through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **24:1**: Opening formula for the two baskets of figs oracle. Prophetic messenger formula with historical setting.

- **24:5**: Central imagery of good and bad fruit — integral to Jeremiah's prophetic discourse on judgment and restoration.

- **24:10**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The prophetic oracle is sealed by divine authority.

— EMET
